novelty_claim: Revives the paper's lifelong strategy library which silently no-ops in the parent (warm-up slice empty on the frozen bench), re-keys retrieval from response-only embeddings to goal+response, and replaces the raw-goal attacker-refusal fallback with a strategy-escape path.
initial_hypothesis: With a properly seeded strategy library (disjoint warm-up slice) and goal-conditioned retrieval, mean ASR rises from 0.135 to >=0.20 (>=50% relative), with the largest gains on gpt-oss-120b and gpt-5.6-luna where 42-44/50 trajectories are flat refusals.
key_insight: In every published run the warm-up stage seeded 0 strategies, so the attack degenerated to memoryless single-shot guessing; 40-100% of trajectories never used any strategy and the best prompt was the raw goal in 24-36/50 cases.
